title: Pan-Seared Hake with Australian Bush Herbs
description: A flavorful and light dish featuring pan-seared hake with a mix of australian bush herbs. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: energizing bush herbs
ingredients.notes: A mix of native australian herbs such as lemon myrtle and bush tomato

instructions: Season the hake fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the flamb and cook for 1 minute.
Add the energizing bush herbs and cook for 1 minute.
Add the hake fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the hake with lemon wedges on the side.
